Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the fix, the provider (bedrock), the affected API (InvokeModel stream), and the changed fields (stop_reason and stop_sequence on message_start). This matches the code, test, and changelog changes in the diff, so the title describes the main change.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description covers the Summary, Changes, Type of change, Affected areas, How to test, Breaking changes, and Related issues sections. It explains the problem, the code change, the new regression test, and the test steps. It omits the template's Screenshots, Security considerations, and Checklist sections. The Screenshots section applies only to UI changes, so its omission is acceptable. The missing Security considerations and Checklist sections are non-critical for this small bug fix.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#9538`] requires `message_start.message` on `/bedrock/model/{id}/invoke-with-response-stream` to carry `stop_reason` and `stop_sequence` as JSON null. The whole-PR diff (merge base b448db4 to head 211412b) for `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` adds `"stop_reason": nil` and `"stop_sequence": nil` to the `msgStart` literal map in `toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes`. Go encodes nil map values as JSON null, so both keys serialize as null. Existing keys (`id`, `type`, `role`, `content`, `model`, `usage`) are unchanged. The whole-PR diff of `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go` adds `TestToAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes_MessageStartHasNullStopFields`. It decodes the first frame, requires the `message` object, and asserts both keys are present and nil. The test covers the requirement as an automated test. The head change since the previous review affects only the comments and the test. The functional change is unchanged in substance. Not run in this review. No coding requirement from [`#9538`] remains unmet.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR changes are: two nil-valued keys (with a explanatory comment) added to the `message_start` map in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go`; a regression unit test in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go`; a changelog entry in `core/changelog.md`; and an e2e regression case in `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json`. The code and unit test implement [`#9538`]. The e2e case and the changelog entry document and check the same behavior, so they support the objective. The `message_delta` branch and `message_start.usage` (the separate concern of [`#5885`]) are not changed by the invoke.go diff. The e2e JSON and changelog were not read directly in this review; they are judged from the change summary and do not change the verdict. No unrelated change is identified.
